planetaryReturn.methodText: Method: planetary return — the chart of the moment the transiting planet returns to (conjoins) its natal longitude; tropical zodiac, apparent geocentric longitude. The return moment is calculated from the birth moment and the birthplace offset; the selected location changes only the Ascendant, the MC and the houses. In a retrograde cycle the planet may cross its natal degree 2–3 times: all crossings in the return cluster closest to the target date are listed and only the selected crossing is calculated (no automatic selection). Consistency check: if the longitude at the return moment is not within 0.05° of the natal longitude, the result is not saved.
planetaryReturn.cycleNote: Because Mercury and Venus move close to the Sun, their geocentric returns occur roughly once a year (the heliocentric orbital periods of 88 / 225 days are not the return interval).
